79-09-02A.t: Filter replacement and inspection of the magnetic chip detector
79-09-02A.txt:
Repair interval                    Nbr installed                    Nbr required                Placard
                  C                                  2                                1                       Yes
        (m) One may be displayed provided that:
            1) The alert is confirmed to be false by troubleshooting, and
            2) The associated filter is replaced before the first MEL dispatch and then every 150 flight
               hours, and
            3) The associated magnetic chip detectors are inspected when the filter is replaced and do
               not reveal the presence of chips.
             Note:      <After Door Closed> Return To Gate
             Note:      <MAINTENANCE>
                        1. Repetitive maintenance actions required - Use the yellow defer placards and
                           make log entry.
                        2. Contact MCC for Defer Control.

                                                       Reference(s)
        (m) Refer to AMM Task 79-35-00-040-809
